summary: Assuming the Riemann hypothesis, we prove an asymptotic lower bound of 85.5579914687% for distinct critical-line zeros counted relative to all zeros counted with multiplicity, in both (T, 2T] and (0, T]. The proof applies Yuanda Xu's counting framework (arXiv:2611.34546v1) through a joint dual certificate whose moment inputs are all proved under RH; the separate simple-zero estimate enters with weight zero. It builds on the Bui–Heath-Brown mollifier method and Kristian Muri Knausgård's earlier Lean formalization.
method: RH, Xu's counting framework for distinct zeros, and a joint dual certificate over mollified-derivative detectors with prime and two-prime sums
model: Astra 6.2, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini Neon, Gemini Carbon
